properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Frontend base URL used to build links in auth emails.

properties.name: app.backend-url
properties.description: Backend base URL used to build sandbox checkout callback links.

properties.name: app.mail.from
properties.description: From address used when sending auth emails.

properties.name: payment.sandbox.secret
properties.description: HMAC secret key for signing sandbox checkout and webhook payloads.

properties.name: app.bootstrap-admin.enabled
properties.description: Enable automatic creation of the first ADMIN account when no admin exists.

properties.name: app.bootstrap-admin.name
properties.description: Display name for the bootstrap admin account.

properties.name: app.bootstrap-admin.email
properties.description: Email for the bootstrap admin account.

properties.name: app.bootstrap-admin.password
properties.description: Raw password for the bootstrap admin account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.enabled
properties.description: Enable local demo data seed (admin/host/user + sample hotels/rooms/bookings/notifications).

properties.name: app.demo-seed.password
properties.description: Raw password used for all demo seed accounts.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.admin-name
properties.description: Display name for the seeded demo admin account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.admin-email
properties.description: Email for the seeded demo admin account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.host-name
properties.description: Display name for the seeded demo host account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.host-email
properties.description: Email for the seeded demo host account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.user-name
properties.description: Display name for the seeded demo user account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.user-email
properties.description: Email for the seeded demo user account.
